experimental_method: Static equilibrium: CO2 saturated with water in a high-pressure bomb at constant temperature; liquid sample expanded and CO2 volume measured at S.T.P. per gram of water (apparatus as in Wiebe and Gaddy 1939).
quality_remarks: Authors note hydrate formation at 10 C and at 12 C above 300 atm, and complete miscibility (identical phases) near 500 atm at 12 C and similar at 18 C. Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (temperatures at constant composition): interpolated/derived from the solubility isotherms (and not measured values per se)
Table III (mole fraction of CO2 in water, experimental and calculated): derived by authors, includes thermodynamic calculation
